meta.note: The repository is backend-only. Light ink #444444 comes from its diagrams; its pure white background was traded for warm paper (#f7f4ee) to avoid the default white-page look. The rest is an original direction.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The page: warm paper, not pure white. (The repo's diagrams use #ffffff; plain white is one of the most common tells of a generated site.)

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, the order summary: a sheet laid on the paper.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: product photo wells, table headers, the customer's own chat messages.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text (8.9:1 on surface light, 11.7:1 dark). Light value from the repo's diagrams.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, prices, totals and the logo: a warm near-black, like printer's ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: specs, stock, dates, captions (4.8:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of things you type in or tap (3.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ledger green, mixed for this brand (not a framework default). Primary buttons, links, focus, the tag in the logo.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tags, the in-cart state. Text on it: brand or ink-strong.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a brand fill (7.5:1 light, 8.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Turmeric. Things happening now: PENDING, the current checkout step, low stock, the cart count. Small doses.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for PENDING badges and warnings; text on it is accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Fern. CONFIRMED, in stock, a finished step. Always with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for CONFIRMED badges and success notes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Brick. CANCELLED, errors, destructive actions.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for CANCELLED badges and error notes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: The small things that make a desk work
styles.usage: At most once per page, left-aligned, at most 16 words wide.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: I use this one on the train every week.
styles.usage: Words a person wrote and signed: staff notes, the order-confirmed message. Never for UI labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stock, dates, helper text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Every price and total, like a printed receipt: digits line up without extra rules.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Category and SKU above a product name, like a shelf label.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Order IDs, correlation IDs, the assistant's sources.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field; between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact rows: cart lines, checkout steps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; product grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: A short break between related sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: A long break before a new part of the page. Vary 40 and 64 on purpose, never the same gap everywhere.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, inputs: nearly square, like printed labels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, photo wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the assistant sheet. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The cart count bubble and nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Only menus, toasts and the assistant sheet. Cards are flat with a hairline.
